lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbTe₂ (Yb₂Te₄ per cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with six atoms in the unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Te centers with 9 geometric neighbors (2 Te, 7 Yb) and Yb centers with 16 neighbors (12 Te, 4 Yb), while the 11-neighbor Te environment is a recognized coordination polyhedron. Corner-, edge-, and face-sharing are observed between the 11-vertex Te polyhedra and between the 16-vertex Yb polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
